newsitem.title: USA: AirWays and COMAIR start code-share.
newsitem.headline: AirWays and COMAIR start code-share.

text.p: AirWays Corp and COMAIR Holdings Inc said Tuesday the code-share agreement announced on April 30 will take off this Thursday.

The agreement, which operates under the name AirTran Florida Connection, connects most of the 23 cities served by AirWays and the nine cities COMAIR serves in Florida and the Bahamas through Orlando International Airport.
The airlines said they expected to add more code-sharing flights than the initial 290 per day and destinations by year-end.
Under the agreement, AirWays and COMAIR coordinate flight schedules and marketing programs. AirWays handles all reservations.

COMAIR operates 89 aircraft to 79 cities in 28 states and three countries. It booked a profit of $0.44 per share in the quarter ended March 31, compared with a $0.37 profit the year before. Its stock opened at unchanged at 24-7/8 today.
AirWays flies between Orlando and 23 cities. Its shares opened unchanged at 5-9/16 today.
